source_context: Publisher-provided 2D pedestrian head-position trajectories from one urban intersection. CSV timestamp, x, and y values are interpreted in the publisher's declared seconds and metres units.
claim_boundary: This report describes one source-locked urban-intersection dataset under its declared filter. It does not calibrate the reference runtime, validate a station or interchange, establish a pedestrian population profile, validate queues, route choice, information behavior, accessibility, evacuation, or safety, and cannot support empirical or operational claims.
